application_rules._note: Application-suitability rules that gate whether the AXG can be quoted at all, independent of the model code. These are checked against the customer's process conditions, not against option selections.

fluid_conductivity.description: Minimum fluid conductivity for the meter to measure. Size-dependent and NON-monotonic - the floor must be looked up per size, not memorized as a single value. Below the floor, the meter physically cannot measure; the agent must reject/flag, not quote.

judgment_threshold.description: Above the hard floor there is a low-conductivity margin zone where the meter works but a senior salesperson would stop auto-quoting and ask questions (or steer to another solution). The datasheet hints at this with its note: 'For measuring low conductivity fluids, read Cautions on Selection and Installation.' Allied to define: at what conductivity (regardless of the published floor) does the agent flag for human review?
judgment_threshold.behavior_when_set: If customer conductivity is above the hard floor but at/below this threshold -> do not auto-quote; flag for engineer review and ask follow-up questions.

fluid_conductivity.agent_behavior: 1) Always ask fluid conductivity if not stated (it is a disqualifying question customers rarely volunteer). 2) Look up the hard floor for the quoted size. 3) Below floor: reject with explanation. 4) Above floor but within judgment zone (once set): flag for review. 5) Comfortably above: proceed.

cross_position_rules.rule: If Construction is a Remote Sensor (D, E, or G), then Power Supply must be -N, Communication and I/O must be NN, Transmitter Wiring Terminal must be N, and Display must be N.

Any non-000 explosion code excludes Use -G/-W/-H, so it FORCES Use = -C. Confirmed: every flameproof code lists '-G, -W, -H' as Not Available. Additionally, all IS-output variants (J-suffix and T-suffix codes, e.g. FJ2/FT2) exclude remote-sensor construction (D/E/G) and require Transmitter Wiring Terminal = 2. See explosion_protection_restrictions for the full per-code mandatory/not-available detail.

allied_defaults._note: Captured from Allied tribal knowledge - selections to assume when a customer does not specify. These are starting points the agent proposes, not hard rules; a reviewer can override.

Use.note: ALWAYS default to -C / A / FF2 unless explicitly overridden. Rationale: an explosion-proof unit is safe in a general-purpose area, but a general-purpose unit in a classified area is a code violation and hazard - the failure is one-directional, so -C fails safe. The agent must NOT infer 'this looks general-purpose' and down-spec on its own; deciding an area is non-hazardous is an engineering/safety call for a human. Down-spec to -G/000 ONLY on an explicit instruction (customer states general-purpose, or a reviewer changes it). When area is unstated, hold -C and ask to confirm rather than assuming.

Construction.note: Integral mount is the default; switch to remote sensor (E/G) only on explicit need (transmitter mounted away from sensor).

Explosion Protection.note: Default FM flameproof, paired with the -C Use default. FJ2 (with IS output) and other approval bodies are explicit-override exceptions, not the default.

Process Connection.note: Allied almost always uses BA1 for flanged connections and AA1 for wafer. Other ratings/standards are exceptions to confirm with the customer.

Communication and I/O.desc: HART 7 + I/O Type A (active 4-20 mA current output + passive pulse/status output, no inputs)
Communication and I/O.note: Selecting HART (J-prefix) excludes explosion code FT2, which is reserved for FOUNDATION Fieldbus / PROFIBUS PA. For a HART build, explosion protection narrows to FF2 (flameproof) or FJ2 (flameproof with IS output).

companion_items._note: Items that are not part of the AXG model code but MUST be quoted alongside it for a complete order. Driven deterministically by model-code selections.

signal_cable.applies_when: Construction is a Remote Sensor (code D, E, or G). Integral (A) needs no signal cable.
signal_cable.rule: A remote sensor requires an AX01C signal cable between sensor and transmitter. The cable variant is determined by the matching transmitter, and the maximum length depends on it.
signal_cable.WARNING_suffix_letters_do_not_align: The AX01C suffix letter does NOT match the construction-code letter except by coincidence. Map explicitly using the table below.

finish.finished: AX01C-B / -C / -D are pre-terminated (finished) for their transmitter.
finish.unfinished: AX01C-A is unfinished - cut to length and field-terminated; not transmitter-specific.

signal_cable.length_spec: Specify length L (1 to 200 m). Length tolerance bands: finished 1-9 m (0/+2%), 10-200 m (0/+1%).
signal_cable.special_case: Marine Approval Type limits cable to 5 m max.
signal_cable.source: Datasheet AX01C section (clean datasheet image) + GS text 'Maximum Cable Length' (lines 407-411). High confidence.

companion_items.refines_red_flag: The earlier red flag 'cable run > 100 m' is now precise: a run over 100 m rules OUT the AXG4A transmitter (100 m max) and requires AXG1A or AXFA11G (200 m max). The agent should steer the transmitter choice accordingly.

key_selection_rules: Grounding-ring material should MATCH the electrode material (L->GRL, H->GRH/GRJ, V->GRV/GRW, P->GRP, T->GRT). Your default electrode L pairs with GRL.
Thin vs thick ring tracks pressure: standard (ASME 150) -> thin (GRL); high pressure/torque (ASME 300, PN40+) -> thick (GRN).
Replacement model (RW) FORCES GAN grounding ring (F316L).
Permeable fluids: exclude electrode-type rings (GRP/GRT) and built-in electrodes (GBP/GBT); recommend Vent Hole (H); pick acid (GC) or alkali (GD) gasket per fluid.

explosion_protection_restrictions._note: The 'Restriction for Explosion protection type' table (datasheet pp. 53-55), verified 2026-06-10. For each explosion code: what it MANDATES and what it makes NOT AVAILABLE. This is the detail position 4 deferred to.
universal_rules: EVERY non-000 explosion code excludes Use -G/-W/-H -> forces Use = -C.
All IS-output variants (J-suffix, T-suffix) exclude remote-sensor Construction (D/E/G) and MANDATE Transmitter Wiring Terminal = 2.
Most codes exclude Optional Code EC (CE Marking) - except the ATEX K-codes, which MANDATE EC.
FM, FMc require Cable Entry 2 (NPT). Most non-North-American codes exclude Cable Entry 0 (JIS G1/2).

allied_default_FF2.desc: FM Flameproof - Allied's standard explosion code
allied_default_FF2.cross_check: FF2 MANDATING Cable Entry 2 confirms Allied's independently-set NPT default. The standard Allied build (FF2 + JA HART + cable entry 2 + /GRL plate ring) is fully compatible - none of FF2's exclusions are hit.
